title: Claims and Loss Settlement Terms by Tier — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Claims and Loss Settlement Terms by Tier — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

The claims desk settles losses under NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) with the tier figures below: the settlement eligibility and sublimits, the coverage of property moved to safety and of basement contents, and the claim deadlines and servicing standards.

| Item | Tenant Contents | Residential Condominium Unit | Manufactured Home | Secondary Single-Family Home | Primary Single-Family Home | Two-to-Four Unit Building |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Occupancy can qualify for replacement cost settlement of building losses when the insurance-to-value test is met | No | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| Share of the building replacement cost value the building limit must reach (or the statutory maximum, whichever is lower) for replacement cost settlement (percent) | 80 | 80 | 80 | 80 | 80 | 80 |
| Multiple of actual cash value capping the special loss settlement of a manufactured home used as a principal residence (0 where not applicable) | 0 | 0 | 1.5 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Sublimit for artwork, jewelry, furs and similar special contents items per loss (USD) | 2500 | 2500 | 2500 | 2500 | 2500 | 2500 |
| Maximum reimbursement for sandbags, fill and pumping supplies bought to protect insured property, with no deductible (USD) | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Days insured property moved away from the premises to protect it from flood stays covered at the safe location (calendar days) | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Contents kept in a basement are covered beyond the listed basement items | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Days after the date of loss within which a signed and sworn proof of loss must be received (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Days after receipt of an accepted proof of loss within which the loss is payable (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Days after an adjuster's report signed by the insured in lieu of proof of loss within which the loss is payable (calendar days) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Days after the date of a written denial within which the policyholder may file an appeal with FEMA (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Months after the date of the written denial within which suit must be filed (calendar months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Tidemark servicing standard for the assigned adjuster to contact the insured after the claim is reported (elapsed hours) | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Building claim payments are issued jointly to the insured and the mortgagee of record | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Points of reading

- Replacement cost settlement of building losses is open only on the **Residential Condominium Unit** and **Primary Single-Family Home** tiers; the insurance-to-value share is 80 percent on every tier.
- The special loss settlement multiple of 1.5 applies only on the **Manufactured Home** tier; every other tier shows 0 (not applicable).
- Special contents items count up to 2500 dollars per loss; loss-avoidance supplies are reimbursed up to 1000 dollars with no deductible; property moved to safety stays covered at the safe location for 45 calendar days.
- A proof of loss is due within 60 calendar days after the date of loss; the loss is payable within 60 calendar days after an accepted proof of loss, or within 90 calendar days after an adjuster's report signed in lieu of it.
- An appeal to FEMA may be filed within 60 calendar days of a written denial and suit within 12 calendar months; the adjuster contact standard is 24 elapsed hours.
